title: Match credentials
description: The per-seat secret returned by the lobby join call. Cached in localStorage under brass:creds:<match-id> by the browser, and in memory by the MCP session.

match-id.description: The match this credential is valid for. Valid for no other match, and for nothing outside moves.

player-id.description: The seat it authenticates, "0" through "3". A string here, while the lobby summary reports the same seat as an integer.

credentials.description: Opaque secret generated by the framework at join. No expiry, no rotation, no revocation. Presented on every move.

name.description: Display name given at join. Cached alongside so a returning tab can show who it is without a round trip.
